# Conditions

<!-- Generated by DocumentationTest. Do not edit by hand:
     run `mvn test -Dbestiary.docs.write=true` after changing a declaration. -->

Only if. Numeric conditions take an optional comparator prefix — `<=`, `>=`, `<`, `>`, `=`, `!=` — followed by an expression; a bare number means `=`. Prefix a condition with `!` to negate it.

52 built in.
